datasets.displayName: OSS YARN User Queue by Total Jobs
queryLines:
select
  user as stage1,
  left(queue,8) as stage2,
  applicationType as stage3,
  totalJobs as value
from
  (
    select
      user,
      queue,
      applicationType,
      startDate,
      totalJobs  
    from
      (
        select
          distinct user,
          queue,
          applicationType,
          finalstatus,
          date(jobStartTime) as startDate,
          date(jobEndTime) as endDate,
          datediff(date(jobEndTime), date(jobStartTime)) as Number_Of_days,
          count(*) as totalJobs,
          round(sum(memorySeconds / 1024 / 60 / 60), 0) as MemoryGBHour_DailyAggregate,
          round(sum(vCoreSeconds / 60 / 60), 0) as vCoreHours_DailyAggregate
        from
          IDENTIFIER(:`catalog` || '.' || :`database` || '.yarn_analysis')
        where
          state = 'FINISHED' 
        group by
          applicationType,
          startDate,
          endDate,
          Number_Of_days,
          finalstatus,
          user,
          queue
        having
          Number_Of_days = 0
        order by
          Number_Of_days desc,
          startDate,
          applicationType,
          finalstatus,
          user,
          queue
      )
 
  )
 
order by
  value desc
limit

queryLines:
SELECT
  distinct substr(name, 1, 30) as ApplicationName,
  case
    when applicationType = 'SPARK'
    and name like '%Hive on%' then 'Spark-Hive'
    when applicationType = 'SPARK'
    and name like '%livy%' then 'Spark-Livy'
    when applicationType = 'SPARK'
    and name like '%PySparkShell%' then 'Spark-Shell'
    when applicationType = 'SPARK' then 'Spark'
    when (
      (
        lower(name) like '%select%'
        or lower(name) like '%insert%'
        or lower(name) like '%create%'
        or lower(name) like '%update%'
        or lower(name) like '%analyze%'
      )
      or (user == 'hive')
    ) then "Hive"
    when (lower(name) like '%airflow%') then "Airflow"
    when (lower(name) like '%oozie%') then "Oozie"
    when (lower(name) like '%pig%') then "Pig"
    when (
      lower(name) like '%sqoop%'
      or lower(name) like '%queryresult.jar%'
    ) then "Sqoop"
    when (lower(name) like '%distcp%') then "DistCP"
    when (lower(name) like '%.jar%') then "Java MapReduce or Custom JAR"
    else "Others"
  end as JobType,
  round(sum(memorySeconds / 1024 / 60 / 60), 0) as MemoryGBHour,
  count(*) as count
FROM
  IDENTIFIER(:`catalog` || '.' || :`database` || '.yarn_analysis')
where
  applicationType = 'MAPREDUCE'
  and state = 'FINISHED'
group by
  ApplicationName,
  JobType

WITH yarn_workload_vw AS (
SELECT 
  case 
    when JobType = 'Oozie' then split(name, 'ID=')[0]
    else name
    end as short_name,
  *
FROM 
(
  SELECT 
  case 
      when applicationType = 'SPARK' and name like '%Hive on%' then 'Spark-Hive'
      when applicationType = 'SPARK' and name like '%livy%' then 'Spark-Livy'
      when applicationType = 'SPARK' and name like '%PySparkShell%' then 'Spark-Shell'
      when applicationType = 'SPARK' then 'Spark'
      when applicationType = 'TEZ' and upper(name) like '%HIVE%' then 'TEZ-Hive'
      when applicationType = 'Informatica Blaze' then 'Informatica'
      when applicationType = 'yarn-service' then 'LLAP'
 
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%select %' or lower(substr(name, 1, 30)) like '%analyze table%' or lower(substr(name, 1, 30)) like '%insert%' or lower(substr(name, 1, 30)) like '%create%' or lower(substr(name, 1, 30)) like '%update%')  then "Hive"
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%(stage-%')  then "Hive"
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%.sql%')  then "Hive-Script"
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%airflow%')  then "Airflow"
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%oozie%')  then "Oozie"    
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%sqoop%')  then "Sqoop"   
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%distcp%')  then "DistCP"   
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%pig%')  then "Pig"   
      when (lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%.jar%' or lower(substr(name, 1, 100)) like '%.java%')  then "MapReduce - JAR"       
      else applicationType || '_' || name
  end as JobType,
  *,
  memorySeconds/1024/60/60 as MemoryGBHour,
  vCoreSeconds/60/60 as vCoreHours
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:`catalog` || '.' || :`database` || '.yarn_analysis')
)
)

            from
              IDENTIFIER(:`catalog` || '.' || :`database` || '.yarn_nodes')
            where
              state = 'RUNNING'
          )

 


select
 
  Count_of_Days,
  Number_Of_days,
  minStartDate,
  maxStartDate,
 
  sumMemoryUtilization / Count_of_Days as avgMemoryUtilization,
  sumCPUUtilization / Count_of_Days as avgCPUUtilization
from
  (
    select
     
      count(startDate) as Count_of_Days,     
      min(startDate) as minStartDate,
      max(startDate) as maxStartDate,
      case
        when datediff(max(startDate), min(startDate)) = 0 then 1
        else datediff(max(startDate), min(startDate))
      end as Number_Of_days,
      sum(MemoryUtilizationPercent) as sumMemoryUtilization,
      sum(CPUUtilizationPercent) as sumCPUUtilization
    from
      (
        select
          startDate,
          state,
          round(MemoryGBHour_DailyAggregate / 24, 0) as AverageMemoryGBPerDay,
          round((MemoryGBHour_DailyAggregate / 1024) / 24, 0) as AverageMemoryTBPerDay,
          round(vCoreHours_DailyAggregate / 24, 0) as AveragevCoreHoursPerDay,
          
          
          round(
            (
              (MemoryGBHour_DailyAggregate / 24) / (select totalYARNMemoryGB from yarn_nodes_vw)
            ) * 100,
            2
          ) as MemoryUtilizationPercent,
          round(
            (
              (vCoreHours_DailyAggregate / 24) / (select totalYARNCores from yarn_nodes_vw)
            ) * 100,
            2
          ) as CPUUtilizationPercent
        from
          (
            select
              distinct date(jobStartTime) as startDate,
              state,
              datediff(date(jobEndTime), date(jobStartTime)) as Number_Of_days,
              count(*) as totalJobs,
              round(sum(memorySeconds / 1024 / 60 / 60), 0) as MemoryGBHour_DailyAggregate,
              round(sum(vCoreSeconds / 60 / 60), 0) as vCoreHours_DailyAggregate
            from
              IDENTIFIER(:`catalog` || '.' || :`database` || '.yarn_analysis')
            
            
            group by
              startDate,
              state,
              Number_Of_days
             
            order by
              startDate
          ) temp 
  
        order by
          startDate
      )
      where 
      MemoryUtilizationPercent > 3 and 
      CPUUtilizationPercent > 3
